title: Tricksters and Exploiters
body: I found the advertisement appealing and went for a 2-week-trial for 10$. However I was tricked into buying a completely useless PDF for 30$, as they charged for it simultaneously. Inquiries for reimbursement were answered by a bot that gradually became more unhinged. I feel really stupid for falling for this in a weak moment. The app is all over the place with prompts and notifications, it may have been adapted with good intensions from something else, but not for the advertised purpose. You literally have to delete your subscription immediately. – Regarding the answer from Savvas’ Robot Army below: Another prime example of gaslighting.
author: lex.vitolic

title: Cancellation and reimbursement
body:
Unfortunately, from my experience I don’t recommend this app. 
They are charging automatically the payments from me and I can’t find any line related to my information except Apple Pay card. I don’t receive even facturation about charged money.
I wanted to try only a trial week and after week unfortunately couldn’t delete my subscription. 

Except open it once, at the first day, I didn’t use this app. 
Customer service hasn’t reply me over the week. It’s a very sad experience. 

Be careful.
author: Sunitei

title: Not recommended!!!
body: I completed the questionnaire and subsequently purchased a paid trial week for 1 $. After finishing the questionnaire, the app presented me with a download button for the workbook. When I clicked on the download button, I was unaware that this action would charge my credit card for the workbook in the background. There was no indication anywhere that this download constituted a purchase. So, be cautious when clicking anything. I reached out to support, but they didn't understand the situation and simply stated there is no refund since it was considered a purchase, even though the charge was unauthorized on their end.

title: REFUND MY MONEY BACK PLEASE
body: I did not want to buy a workbook for 29 $ I just wanted to try a 3-Days-Version for 1 $ that’s all! But the questions tricks you to buy this book without ANY useful information in it. I don’t even remember how this mistake happened to me. The PDF consists of 33 Pages of so called “routine-tracker” something you can literally download in the internet. The help advices in the app are really cheesy and don’t seem professional to me. Now it gets worse: this cheap PDF was booked twice from my account, so I paid around 60 franks for nothing. Please answer my email and send me my money back! Thanks for nothing!
author: Sesa_89

title: The worst Subscription i have ever purchased
body: I bought 1 year premium subscription and it was the biggest mistake ever. The features are not worth at all. Doesn't even have an option to change the theme or profile photo. Takes forever to build a habit tracking or even to delete the unwanted ones. The least developed app available for premium subscription, I would say. Tried to reach out for the refund within 24 hours of purchasing because 26CHF for 1 year for this app is disgustingly not worth it at allllll. But haven't hear back since then.
